messages:
Ravi: Spike idea: add a server-side preview safety gate that returns an "impact_score" (0-1) and blocks canary promos if >0.7. Lightweight, explainable signals only.
Ava: Which signals? Suggest p95 delta, 5xx delta, and success_rate delta. Normalize per-tenant.
Marta: Add confidence = sample_count_scaled so low-volume tenants see a 'low confidence' banner instead of a hard block.
Ravi: API sketch: POST /v1/configs/preview body {config, traffic_percent, mode:"block|warn"} => {impact_score, confidence, blocked, reasons:[...], preview_id}.
Ava: Telemetry: emit preview.impact_check with tags tenant_id, preview_id, sample_count, impact_score, reasons. Makes dashboards simple.
Marta: UX: show top 2 reasons inline and a "suggested mitigation" line (e.g., reduce batch_size, route to low-latency pool). Also allow platform admins to force-promote with 2-person approval.
Ravi: Implementation plan: control-plane service computes score using recent metrics windows; preview is idempotent and persisted for audits. Fallback suggestion is heuristic-based.
infra-bot: Note: ensure preview events are rate-limited and cheap for infra.
Ava: I'll draft the RFC with API contract, event schema, and console mocks. Assigning to Marta for UI and Ravi for backend.
Marta: ack.
Ravi: ack.
